meta: Retyping the same long prompt every week, and always forgetting something? The last part of the series puts every trick into one template: a prompt template with blanks, combining role, examples and more.

muc.title: Retyping from scratch every time
muc.text: Every week Mark retypes the same long prompt to write a report, and every time he forgets something.

muc.title: One template, used forever
muc.text: Bit says: make a prompt template, a template with blanks. Combine the tricks from this series: role, examples, step by step, output format and self-critique.

muc.title: A weekly report template
muc.text: For example, a weekly report template: you are the assistant to a sales team lead. This week's numbers: paste here. Answer with three bullet points and one action for next week.

muc.title: Somewhere easy to grab
muc.text: Keep the template somewhere easy to grab: a notes file, a Project, or turn it into a Skill, as in videos 28, 66 and 67.

muc.title: Fix the template after each use
muc.text: Whenever AI's result isn't quite right, don't just fix the answer. Fix the template too, so the same mistake doesn't happen again.

muc.title: Six tricks from the series
muc.text: In short, six tricks: few-shot, role, chain of thought, output format, prompt chaining and self-critique.

muc.title: Write your first template
muc.text: Pick the task you ask AI for most, write it as a template with blanks, and use it all this week.
